---
title: "支援4月"
author: "yuiy"
date: "2026-04-05"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)

path <- "C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/花蓮縣公車.csv"
data <- read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

date1 <- as.Date(data$資料代表日期.yyyy.MM.dd.)
data$year <- year(date1)
data$month <- month(date1)


data <- data %>%
  filter(year == 2025, month %in% 1:6)


data$票種 <- recode(data$持卡身分,
  "A" = "普通(含TPASS)",
  "B" = "學生",
  "C01" = "敬老優待",
  "C02" = "愛心優待",
  "C09" = "其他優待",
  "D" = "員工",
  "X" = "無法區別"
)


card_table <- table(data$票種)


card_table <- sort(card_table, decreasing = TRUE)


percent <- round(prop.table(card_table) * 100, 1)


png(
  "C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/114年1月至114年6月花蓮縣市區客運持卡身分長條圖.png",
  width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", res = 300
)

windowsFonts(yui = windowsFont("Microsoft JhengHei"))

par(
  family = "yui",
  mar = c(4,2,6,2),
  xpd = NA
)


bp <- barplot(
  card_table,
  col = gray.colors(length(card_table), start=0.3, end=0.9),
  main = "",
  ylab = "",
  xlab = "",
  axes = FALSE,   
  border = NA,
  cex.names = 0.9
)


title(
  main = "114年1月至114年6月花蓮縣市區客運持卡身分長條圖",
  adj = 0.085
)


text(
  bp,
  card_table,
  labels = paste0(sprintf("%.1f", percent), "%"),
  pos = 3,
  cex = 0.9
)


dev.off()
```
